changes.title: Props gen default
items: The forest's stones, cairns, pools, logs, stumps, mushroom rings, stone circles, boulders, mounds, bridges and party decorations now come in many shapes instead of repeating one, and fingerposts stand where footpaths reach a clearing (add ?props=hand to the link to see the old ones)

changes.title: Fingerposts
items: With ?props=gen, old wooden fingerposts stand where footpaths come into a clearing, each with its own arms, top and lean

changes.title: Prop bridges
items: With ?props=gen, the bridges where paths cross streams come in different shapes: arched or flat footbridges with rails, posts or none, sagging rope bridges, and root bridges with ferns and bushes at their ends
